run_checkpoint_surgery: run the uma_1p2_surgery script with --checkpoint-in and --output-dir to produce stage1 and stage2 checkpoints
add_omat_rattle_support: add omat_rattle dataset support to a FAIRChem checkpoint by cloning omat embeddings and updating dataset mappings
remove_omat_rattle: remove omat_rattle from a checkpoint by deleting embeddings, resizing expert weights from 8 to 7, and enabling single atom support
compare_checkpoints: compare two checkpoint files across all tasks and PBC/non-PBC systems to verify energy and force outputs match
create_test_systems: create PBC and non-PBC H2O test systems with charge and spin metadata for checkpoint validation
